column1: # Archive formats for unpack and pack. Columns (tab-separated):
#   extensions     separated by |, first is the one pack uses
#   unpack into    {dir} = target folder (slash creates it first); - = not possible
#   pack needs     programs; - = can't pack this format
#   pack           {archive} = new archive, {files} = what goes in; - = none
# Templates must run in bash, zsh and fish alike.
# Several rows for the same extensions are alternatives: slash uses the
# first one whose programs are installed, so nobody has to install a tool
# just to pack or unpack. Unpacking never overwrites files (tar/bsdtar -k;
# unzip and 7z ask), so no alternative may overwrite silently.
